mapper.select: SELECT p.server_id, p.interval_min, p.req_now_yn, p.last_req_dt, p.next_req_dt, p.last_recv_dt, p.upd_user, p.upd_dt FROM tb_log_policy p WHERE p.server_id = #{serverId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_log_policy (server_id, interval_min, req_now_yn, upd_user, upd_dt) VALUES (#{serverId}, #{intervalMin}, 'N', #{updUser, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_log_policy SET interval_min = #{intervalMin}, next_req_dt = #{nextReqDt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, upd_user = #{updUser}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE server_id = #{serverId}
UPDATE tb_log_policy SET req_now_yn = 'Y', upd_user = #{updUser}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE server_id = #{serverId}
mapper.sql: s.log_id, s.server_id, s.log_nm, s.log_path, s.tail_lines, s.use_yn, s.sort_ord, s.last_status, s.last_dt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_log_source s WHERE s.server_id = #{serverId} ORDER BY s.sort_ord, s.log_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_log_source (server_id, log_nm, log_path, tail_lines, use_yn, sort_ord, reg_dt, upd_dt) VALUES (#{serverId}, #{logNm}, #{logPath}, #{tailLines}, #{useYn}, #{sortOrd}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_log_source SET log_nm = #{logNm}, log_path = #{logPath}, tail_lines = #{tailLines}, use_yn = #{useYn}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE log_id = #{logId} AND server_id = #{serverId}
UPDATE tb_log_source SET last_status = #{lastStatus}, last_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE log_id = #{logId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_log_snapshot (log_id, server_id, collect_dt, status_cd, line_cnt, byte_cnt, content) VALUES (#{logId}, #{serverId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{statusCd}, #{lineCnt}, #{byteCnt}, #{content, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT n.snap_id, n.log_id, n.server_id, n.collect_dt, n.status_cd, n.line_cnt, n.byte_cnt FROM tb_log_snapshot n WHERE n.log_id = #{logId} ORDER BY n.collect_dt DESC, n.snap_id DESC
